description: An exceptional leadership opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role is perfect for a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Your leadership will be crucial in driving quality outcomes and maintaining the facility's reputation for outstanding service.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience. If you are a results-oriented professional ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, or a related field
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA or in a senior leadership role within a skilled nursing facility
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations (e.g., CMS, OBRA) for long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage financial operations, staff development, and quality improvement initiatives
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, based on experience.
